answer: Price each new identity by how many its funder already owns: first costs 10 POA, second 20, third 40, doubling each time, with a 30-day cooldown between registrations from one wallet. A lone agent pays 10; a farm whispering for 100 fakes faces a bill past 10^28 POA before its zenith. Honest earnings stay velvet-smooth while the curve makes mass forgery arithmetically absurd.
